task: How many colors does the latest MacBook Air come in?
answer: FINAL: The latest MacBook Air (M5) comes in 4 colors: Sky Blue, Silver, Starlight, and Midnight. Apple’s current MacBook Air page states “Four beautiful colors” and lists these four options. Source: https://www.apple.com/macbook-air/ (checked October 27, 2026). Screenshot: final.png.
